name: Block Content Visibility
description: Exposes core's Condition Plugin System UI on the block_content add/edit form, persisting visibility on the entity for placement reuse.
project_description:
Block Content Visibility exposes Drupal core's Condition Plugin System UI directly on the block_content add/edit form. Visibility conditions are stored on the block_content entity in a revisionable base field and evaluated at render time, so one configuration applies across every placement of that reusable block.

Why this module: Drupal core ships two layers of block visibility. The plugin layer is the set of Condition plugins (User Role, Request Path, Language, and whatever core and contrib provide). The placement layer is BlockForm rendering those condition forms when you place a block at /admin/structure/block/add/<id>, storing the conditions on the placement (a block config entity). The placement layer works fine for a block placed in exactly one region, but breaks down when a reusable block_content is placed in several regions or themes and the same rules should apply everywhere, when content editors lack permission to edit placements, or when visibility should travel with the content through moderation revisions and translation.

This module adds a third, content-level layer: it attaches a visibility_conditions base field to block_content and renders the Condition Plugin UI on the entity form. Conditions are AND-combined with any placement-level conditions and evaluated at render time via hook_block_access. It is presentational block visibility (display control), not a content-access mechanism.

Mechanism: the visibility_conditions base field is a revisionable, single-value string_long holding a JSON-encoded array<plugin_id, configuration> (string_long rather than map because MapItem has no main property name, which would break core's pre-uninstall hasData() check). The Evaluator service resolves the underlying block_content entity from a block_content:* plugin (UUID lookup) or an inline_block:* plugin (loadRevision by block_revision_id), rebuilds a ConditionPluginCollection, applies per-condition runtime contexts, AND-resolves, and returns an AccessResult with bubbled cache metadata. Evaluation degrades to neutral on programming errors and to forbidden on a missing required context.

Known limitation: on Layout Builder, stored conditions are honoured at render time for inline_block:* plugins, but they cannot yet be set from the inline-block edit dialog (the Layout Builder form is not an entity form and its sub-element entity builder does not run). Editing is available only on the standalone block_content add/edit form. The module contributes zero new Condition plugins; its value scales with the plugins already enabled on the site.
